title: Circular queue simulator
description: Implement simulate(capacity, operations) with a fixed-size circular queue. Operations are ["put", value] or ["get"]. A successful put returns True, a full queue returns False, and get returns the oldest value or None when empty. Return the list of operation results. capacity is positive; queued values are integers. Use head, tail and count, not pop(0).
hints: Track count to distinguish full from empty.
